scope: Deterministic mathematical calculation using declared synthetic covariates; no clinical prediction validity claim.
rules: Reject unsupported drug, binding conflicts, known context outside reported ranges, missing covariates or unlisted administration amounts.
Require an explicitly represented synthetic disease declaration.
Restrict to a fixed 0.1-hour display grid, daily events from time zero and at most 72 hours.
Keep source-review blockers and unknown context visible; no missing value is filled.
All random effects and observation error are omitted.
Execution limits are conservative project policy, not a published clinical regimen or validation boundary.
